reader.edition-search: grep of ImageInitializer.cs, GroupImageCodec.cs, BitImageCodec.cs, GroupValueSlicer.cs and OccurrenceRunEmit.cs for Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior: none. reader.notes: PB2337 split GroupImageCodec into GroupImageCodec (the run-time AsImage/FromImage codec), BitImageCodec and ImageInitializer (the compile-time initial-image composer); AreaImageOf, ImageInitOf and OccurrenceRunsOf moved with their bodies unchanged to ImageInitializer, wired by DataEmitter (PhysicalModel.Images) and reached from the Tier-B backing seed and GroupValueSlicer.MemberFromSlice (BackingSeedOver). Re-read at the branch head against the 1985 text. ImageInitOf composes an OCCURS entry once per occurrence run (OccurrenceRunsOf: TableValueRuns.Of where VALUEs apply, which for a format 1 VALUE is one run over every occurrence), and the recursion through InitImageOfMember repeats nested tables. No edition arm on the path.

refuter.evidence: Code read independently at the branch head: ImageInitializer.cs carries AreaImageOf, ImageInitOf and OccurrenceRunsOf with no edition read (grep Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior over ImageInitializer, GroupImageCodec, BitImageCodec, GroupValueSlicer, OccurrenceRunEmit: none); GroupImageCodec.cs keeps only the run-time AsImage/FromImage codec, which seeds nothing. OccurrenceRunsOf answers TableValueRuns.Of, which with no table VALUE in the subtree is one run (1..n, period 1): every occurrence takes the format 1 VALUE. Attack on the combinations the reader left out, each through an alias so the image lane seeds it: r1.cob at --std 85, 05 E2 OCCURS 3 with a subordinate GROUP VALUE "MN" beside 10 K2 PIC 9 VALUE 5 printed R2 [MN5MN5MN5], F2B(3)=N, K2(3)=5; 05 E3 OCCURS 2 holding A3 VALUE "AB" redefined in place by B3 printed G3 [ABAB] A3(2)=AB. The same at --std 2023. Cite: OK  §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR6  (5.15.6 Data Description Entries Other Than Condition-Names)  the text is in GR6
